test_title: PYST 8: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 06 Feb, 2025 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: SBFU is related to VDHX in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, HOXA is related to KQZD. To which of the given options is ZEPI related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef1a08d1ac261dc312fe06bf091df2a759e46479c435e13d4eef66d50fd21097.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, SBFU is related to VDHX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d7100fcff67902ab6ea00f8a46c833d0fa9c0ee2f234e43db0ec74d52b6b928.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83e5a0e573c1506fe53d8e77d85f302866cabd9afd5f584cf75ff133f9ed84c6.png] 

For, HOXA is related to KQZD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a248a241d678e0a4af73507c0c6196ae47787c875f40bc072c444949de6a27af.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd58dee2f104341dc25b65f33876ddd2b0d21c630be3f44a2a88b84a2f23a689.png] 

Similarly, for 'ZEPI'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/886fed1b2b987c1d5a3a4a35e414287081654ba6fad63f9d9ec6543ca85a393a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40d3e0e0df40d1ef9c345d35012410b251465fdbdb49da068f79903b6cd1adf3.png] 

So, '**ZEPI**' will be related to '**CGRL**'

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
